mentions.name: The Pelota
mentions.description: A free, ad-free streaming site that aggregates soccer highlights from all the major leagues in one place, adding them as soon as they become available on YouTube — like Netflix for soccer highlights.
mentions.audience: Soccer fans who love catching up on highlights
mentions.source_excerpt:
If you love catching up on highlights, check https://thepelota.tv/

It’s like Netflix but for soccer highlights, with all the major leagues in one place as soon as they are available on YouTube, all free and no ads.
